article.story: POUGHKEEPSIE, N.Y. -- — Brent Bland had 14 points in Saint Peter's 63-56 victory over Marist on Sunday. Bland added eight rebounds for the Peacocks (17-11, 14-6 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Zaakir Williamson added nine points while finishing 4 of 6 from the floor while they also had six rebounds. Jahki Gupton shot 3 for 4, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc to finish with nine points. Justin Menard led the Red Foxes (18-11, 12-8) in scoring, finishing with 19 points and two steals. Marist also got eight points, 10 rebounds and two steals from Jadin Collins. Parby Kabamba finished with eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
